records.failureSummary: Implemented and exported escapeHtml and escapeAttr in src/render.mjs (only backend file changed). escapeHtml is a single-pass replace over &, <, >, double quote and single quote mapping to &, <, >, ", ', which escapes ampersand first and therefore never double-escapes generated entities. escapeAttr coerces input via String() and escapes & then the double quote for URL values placed in href. npm run build and npm run lint both exit 0. Scoped run of the [AC-05]/[AC-06] tests gives 12 tests, 9 pass, 3 fail: all 3 AC-06 tests pass and 5 of 6 AC-05 escaping tests pass. Two blockers remain and both are outside this backend task's write scope: (1) test/render.test.mjs line 54 asserts escapeHtml leaves single quotes raw inside a combined string, which contradicts line 39 (single quote must become ' or ') and the title (line 151), heading (lines 210-213) and link-text (line 324) escaping tests, so no single correct escapeHtml can satisfy both; (2) two tests named [AC-05] (lines 126, 154) call renderPage, which is still the stub owned by another task in the render-core slice. Per the change-only-backend-files constraint I did not edit or weaken the test or the helper. Replan needed: correct the contradictory line-54 expectation (or remove that combined assertion) so the T-02 escaping set can go green; AC-05 then becomes green once the renderPage task lands. API contracts preserved and trust-boundary input coerced safely; no existing signatures changed.
